text.tspan: CloudFront: a CDN in front of your origin; edge locations cache and protect
1. Performance: content cached near users (hundreds of edge locations worldwide); lower latency, less load and cost on the origin
2. Security: TLS at the edge (ACM cert in us-east-1), AWS WAF + Shield Standard (DDoS), geo-blocking, signed URLs/cookies,
Origin Access Control so the S3 bucket is never public; the origin can accept only CloudFront traffic
3. Single entry point: one domain routing /static to S3 and /api to ALB by cache behaviour
4. Edge logic: CloudFront Functions (headers, redirects) and Lambda@Edge (heavier logic)
Ops: cache key + TTLs (Cache-Control headers), invalidation /* after a deploy (or versioned file names), access logs, 4xx/5xx metrics
